sources.title: Modly — Free Local AI 3D Model Generator | Open Source, Offline
sources.snippet: Turn any photo or text prompt into a 3D model with local AI. Export as GLB, OBJ, STL or PLY. Free, open source, runs entirely on your GPU — no cloud, no account.
